messages:
maria-cs: Acme reported a spike of 403s on their batch rerank job right after our nightly key rotation. Only /v1/batch/rerank is failing, single-item rerank and generation endpoints are fine. Error: "missing_entitlement: rerank"
ken-support: Oof. Any repro steps or logs from the customer?
maria-cs: They gave a minimal repro. Sequence: CI job calls our token-rotation webhook to swap keys, then their batch job POSTs to /v1/batch/rerank with the rotated key. Curl they provided: 
```
# token just rotated, bearer token used verbatim
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ROTATED_KEY}" \
  -d '{"queries": [...]}'
```
Response: 403 + body: "error: missing_entitlement: rerank". Customer confirmed new key works for single rerank: `/v1/rerank` but fails for `/v1/batch/rerank`.
oliver-ingest: Interesting. Do we log the token provisioning details server-side? I can check provisioner events.
maria-cs: I attached their provisioner trace (they redacted tenant id). Key created at 2026-03-15T07:02:01Z with scopes set to: `inference embeddings rerank` (space-separated). But our token-introspect log for the same token (when batch call arrives) shows entitlements: `[inference, embeddings]` — rerank missing.
shiv-ml: Could be a parsing mismatch along the request path. Do they use any proxy/sidecar for CI containers?
maria-cs: Yes — they have an internal ci-sidecar that normalizes headers and rewrites Authorization occasionally. They said sidecar upgrades were rolled out the same night as rotation.
ken-support: Can you reproduce internally? Maybe our batch endpoint reads scopes from a different claim (e.g., `scope` vs `scopes`) and the sidecar strips one?
maria-cs: Repro I ran locally with a replicated sidecar (we use their docker image). Steps: 1) create test key with scopes `inference,embeddings,rerank` (comma-separated) using admin API, 2) run sidecar that rewrites headers (it URL-encodes header values), 3) call /v1/batch/rerank. Result: 403. Logs show our auth middleware received header `x-scopes: inference%2Cembeddings` (truncated: rerank dropped during urlencode/truncate).
```
# simplified python snippet that reproduces the customer's path
import requests
key = 'rotated-test-key'
headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {key}', 'X-Client-Scopes': 'inference,embeddings,rerank'}
# sidecar transforms header to URL-encoded and truncates beyond 32 chars in their image
# we emulate that transform
headers['X-Client-Scopes'] = requests.utils.quote(headers['X-Client-Scopes'])[:32]
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch/rerank', headers=headers, json={"queries":["a","b"]})
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```
oliver-ingest: That nails it. Our batch endpoint has a backward-compatible code path that reads scopes from `X-Client-Scopes` (legacy) in addition to token claims, because some older proxies used to send scopes via header. The header-parsing code expects comma-separated values and stops on the first invalid char. URL-encoding plus truncation -> `inference%2Cembeddings` becomes a token we don't parse into `rerank`.
shiv-ml: So two bugs aligned: customer sidecar URL-encodes+truncates header, and our legacy header-parsing is overly strict and used by batch path. Why only batch? The batch handler still uses the legacy header flow for batching optimization to short-circuit claim introspection for cold paths. Single-item rerank goes through full introspect and sees rerank entitlement.
ken-support: Customer-facing impact: their nightly batch jobs fail and silently skip until they get the 403. Any quick mitigations?
maria-cs: Workaround steps we provided to Acme: 1) Recreate rotated key via admin UI with explicit comma-separated `scopes` claim in the token payload (not header) — that ensures token-introspect carries correct entitlements. 2) Alternatively, flip their sidecar config to stop URL-encoding headers (they rolled back to previous sidecar image and confirmed batch jobs started succeeding).
shiv-ml: Permanent fix: I'll submit a PR to batch auth flow to prefer token introspection claims (never trust legacy header) and make header parsing tolerant (accept URL-encoded values and decode before splitting, and accept both commas and spaces). Also add a detection metric when `X-Client-Scopes` present but token claims mismatch -> alert.
oliver-ingest: I'll instrument logs to include both the raw header and introspected scopes for 48h for any incoming batch rerank requests from tenants on nightly rotations so we can measure prevalence.
ken-support: Great. Maria, please share repro snippet with the customer and the rollback steps. Also offer to rotate their keys now with the corrected policy if they prefer.
maria-cs: Sent the workaround instructions and offered immediate rotation. Customer accepted the temporary rotation and rolled back sidecar to previous image — their nightly runs completed. They asked for a permanent fix ETA.
shiv-ml: I'll open the PR now and tag `eng-oncall` and `eng-security` for review; ETA 3 business days for a patch and 2 weeks for rollout after staging verification.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: patch-auth-batch-header-fix -> staging. CI pipeline will run e2e with sidecar image matrix.
ken-support: Closing loop: customer happy for now. Keeping thread open until patch is live. :thumbsup:
